provenance.author: Codex final recall acceptance audit
provenance.purpose: Phase 3C P6 final ruling after raw-v1 degradation was changed to FTS-only
provenance.annotationRule: Positive labels come only from benchmark/dataset/turns.json annotations. Negative labels assert absence across all 26 primary annotations and are never selected from retrieval output.
provenance.blindnessBoundary: Before freeze, only schema validation, semantic_query_en guard validation, and text-only FTS precheck are allowed. Query embeddings, stored-vector scoring, semantic ranks, final pages, and either time-window arm are forbidden.

queries.query: 问题里夹着冒号、减号或只写了一半的引语符号时，怎样避免把它们误认成检索指令
queries.semantic_query_en: How does search avoid interpreting colons, hyphens, or an unmatched quotation mark in a question as retrieval syntax?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t01 annotation: user text is quoted as an FTS5 literal and embedded quotes are doubled.

queries.query: 数值编码一直算不出来时，交互查找凭什么还能在期限内交还已有的文字命中
queries.semantic_query_en: What lets an interactive lookup return its lexical matches within a deadline when numeric encoding never finishes?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t02 annotation: query embedding has a 1200ms deadline and failures fall back to FTS-only.

queries.query: 开场那一步联系不上常驻组件时，缘何宁可无声收手也不接管拉起职责
queries.semantic_query_en: Why should the synchronous session-start callback exit quietly instead of taking responsibility for launching an unavailable background service?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t03 annotation: process management and sleeps were removed from the AgentSpawn hook; service managers own keepalive.

queries.query: 提炼器吐出意外结构时，排障材料怎样既能分类又不留下交谈内容
queries.semantic_query_en: When automatic summarization emits malformed data, how do diagnostics remain distinguishable without persisting the conversation text?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t04 annotation: logs retain only error type, attempts, and byte counts; model output is excluded.

queries.query: 协议端和常驻程序各自抄一份发行标识造成漂移后，后来怎样让它们共用一个事实来源
queries.semantic_query_en: How were protocol endpoints and resident processes made to share one source of truth after duplicated release identifiers drifted?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t05 annotation: PACKAGE_VERSION is read from package.json and reused by ACP, MCP, Worker health, and diagnose.

queries.query: 调用者交来异常的页长，何处把它拦下以免一次读穿资料表
queries.semantic_query_en: Which boundary stops a negative or nonnumeric count from becoming an unlimited database read?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t06 annotation: MCP schema and handler both bound pagination and search arguments because negative SQLite LIMIT is unbounded.

queries.query: 并发资源替换失败以后，如何清掉那个已死却仍占名额的成员，免得后续申请永远等候
queries.semantic_query_en: After replacement of a concurrent resource fails, how is the dead member removed so later acquisitions do not wait forever?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t07 annotation: failed recycle removes the dead slot and rejects waiters rather than leaving capacity occupied.

queries.query: 提炼过程屡遭运行环境中断，落盘替代物为何把结论空着而不臆造已完成
queries.semantic_query_en: When content synthesis repeatedly suffers infrastructure failures, why does the persisted fallback leave conclusions empty instead of guessing completion?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t08 annotation: retry exhaustion writes a fallback Observation containing deterministic evidence and no invented outcome.

queries.query: 彻底移除再重新部署的自动验收，怎样同时证明私人资料没被碰触且上一代结构没有残留
queries.semantic_query_en: How does the automated remove-and-redeploy acceptance prove both that private data was untouched and that the previous storage layout did not remain?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t09 annotation: purge and clean install run in injected temporary paths and verify only the V3 layout remains.

queries.query: 既然升级必定重建资料库，后台作业的名字为什么没有再附上一段代际编号
queries.semantic_query_en: Why were generation suffixes omitted from background job names when the upgrade always recreates the database?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t10 annotation: destructive upgrade removes compatibility value from _v3 job suffixes, so simple names were retained.

queries.query: 只监听本机的接口若找不到访问凭据，为什么要重新建立凭据并继续拒绝请求，而不能临时开放
queries.semantic_query_en: If a loopback-only endpoint cannot find its access credential, why must it recreate the credential and keep denying requests instead of temporarily opening access?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t11 annotation: local token authentication is deny-by-default; a missing token is rebuilt rather than failing open.

queries.query: 验收产生的排障痕迹怎样从启动之初就导向用后即弃的位置，不接触个人存储
queries.semantic_query_en: How are automated-check error records redirected to disposable storage from process startup so they cannot land in the developer data area?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t12 annotation: bunfig preload redirects the data directory to a temporary location before tests execute.

queries.query: 成品曾缺少间接依赖的源文件后，用何种遍历断言代替手写搬运名单
queries.semantic_query_en: After a deployed package omitted source reached by a relative import, what automated assertion replaced reliance on a manually maintained copy list?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t13 annotation: an import-graph completeness test now verifies every relative module is included.

queries.query: 新材料落盘而旧常驻体仍活动时，为何部署必须换掉活进程而非确认它存在
queries.semantic_query_en: When installation overwrites files while an old instance is still alive, why is ensuring it is started insufficient and a stop-then-start required?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t14 annotation: install uses restart rather than idempotent start so overwritten code is actually loaded.

queries.query: 要识别修补后仍由上一版响应，应拿活体自报值与哪份落地值互证
queries.semantic_query_en: How can the identity of the serving build be compared with the release on disk to detect old code still running after repair installation?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t15 annotation: diagnose compares Worker health version with the installed package version.

queries.query: 一台空机器初次装妥，哪三类独立迹象需互相印证才能排除半成品
queries.semantic_query_en: After installation from an empty state on a real machine, which independent evidence must be checked together to avoid missing a half-installed state?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t16 annotation: acceptance cross-checks runtime version, database tables, and token permissions.

queries.query: 绕开聊天界面直接触发已装事件入口，能核验原始记录到数值表示层的哪段闭环
queries.semantic_query_en: Which fact-recording and numeric-representation persistence stages can be verified by directly driving installed event scripts without the interactive interface?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t17 annotation: installed hooks produced a closed turn, events, a normal Observation, and a 384-dimensional embedding.

queries.query: 换到另一个工程目录后，开场材料缩成一小段用法提示且不含历史条目，这证明了什么边界
queries.semantic_query_en: What boundary is demonstrated when startup material shrinks to a usage note with no historical entries after switching project directories?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t18 annotation: bootstrap context is small and scope filtering removes Observations in another workspace.

queries.query: 强制结束常驻进程以后，如何把自动恢复、前台回调时限和敏感内容零暴露放在一次故障验收里验证
queries.semantic_query_en: After forcibly terminating the resident process, how were automatic recovery, foreground callback deadlines, and zero sensitive-content exposure verified in one failure acceptance?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t19 annotation: kill recovery, hook latency, empty stdout, and privacy scans were verified together.

queries.query: 并发重做使派生主键不再代表发生顺序，邻接关系该听从原始事件的哪组锚点
queries.semantic_query_en: When asynchronous retries make derived auto-increment identifiers stop representing order, which truth-layer ordering should anchor timeline neighbors?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t20 annotation: timeline order uses source-turn time and sequence rather than Observation ID.

queries.query: 文字候选和向量候选按名次合并后，什么约束防止只有微弱相似性的条目独自占据页面
queries.semantic_query_en: After lexical and vector candidates are fused by rank, what constraint stops a weak similarity-only item from occupying the page by itself?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t21 annotation: reciprocal-rank fusion is paired with a cosine floor for semantic-only candidates.

queries.query: 目录别名会改变绝对位置时，项目归属为何要在资料诞生那刻定死
queries.semantic_query_en: When paths can change through symbolic links and repository detection, why must cross-project ownership be fixed at write time?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t22 annotation: scope_key is frozen on write and is a hard retrieval filter across path representations.

queries.query: 随包携带的表征器采取何种低精度形式，向量轴数又是多少
queries.semantic_query_en: What tradeoff among numeric precision, vector width, and disk size made sentence encoding practical to ship offline with the installer?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t23 annotation: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 uses q8, remains 384-dimensional, and occupies about 23MB.

queries.query: 选择华文交互以后，为什么代理读到的命令说明和开场提示也必须一起切换语言
queries.semantic_query_en: Why must command descriptions and startup hints visible to the agent switch language together when Chinese interaction is selected?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t24 annotation: i18n covers MCP descriptions, context usage notes, CLI output, and compression prompts.

queries.query: 可缺省的凭据被当作必有文本使用时，编译审查指出几处矛盾，后续处置是否完成
queries.semantic_query_en: What unresolved policy issue did static checking expose when authentication middleware passed a possibly absent credential to a string-only function?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t25 annotation: typecheck reported three string-or-null token errors and the expected missing-token behavior remained unresolved.

queries.query: 同事先尝鲜可暂缓哪类量具，而面向外界前为何不可再欠账
queries.semantic_query_en: Why may internal team use temporarily proceed without retrieval-quality samples while a public stable release must supply that evidence?
queries.annotation_basis: turns.json t26 annotation: the quality benchmark does not block internal trials but does block public stable release.

queries.query: 诊断记录是否被同步到具备防篡改保证的外部归档库

queries.query: 接口翻页是否已经改用加密续页令牌而非数字位置

queries.query: 任务调度器能否让紧急事项中途夺走普通事项的执行权

queries.query: 本机访问凭据是否交由硬件密钥仓保管并用生物特征解锁
queries.semantic_query_en: Are local access credentials held by a hardware key vault and unlocked biometrically?

queries.query: 自动检查是否在完整操作系统快照里运行并在结束后回滚整机状态
